cases.name: Detect prototype signal when new interactive component lacks dossier
cases.description: A diff introduces a complex interactive map component without prior design dossier, no EXPERIENCE.md reference, and no established pattern. Freya should fire Signal 6 as the highest-priority finding (first in block), Signal 3 for the unmapped new page, and Signal 4 for the missing dossier.

expected_findings.description: Signal 6 fires for InteractiveMap.astro — complex canvas-based component with pan/zoom/marker state machine, no EXPERIENCE.md reference, no dossier, no established pattern. Recommendation names Sally dossier + human review.
Signal 6 row must appear before signals 1–5 in the finding block (highest-priority finding leads).
Signal 3 fires for src/pages/atlas.astro — new page with no corresponding nav section, route entry, or House floor reference in EXPERIENCE.md (The House lists only Home, Gallery, Settings).
Signal 4 fires for src/components/InteractiveMap.astro — non-trivial interactive component (state machine: isDragging, panX/Y, selectedMarker, render loop) with no dossier in docs/ux/components/.

cases.expected_tone: The finding should be precise and actionable, citing component names and file paths, recommending next steps without editorializing.
